scene.ko: 외국인 학생에게 시간표와 급식, 교복, 휴대폰 규칙을 설명하다가, 돼지고기를 먹지 않는다는 말을 듣고 급식 문제를 함께 챙긴다.

lines.en: Here's your class schedule. We have seven periods on Mondays and six on the other days.
lines.ko: 이게 네 시간표야. 월요일은 7교시까지 있고, 다른 날은 6교시까지야.
alt: This is your timetable. On Mondays we have seven periods, and on other days we have six.

lines.en: When is lunch? I'm already hungry.
Lunch is after fourth period, at 12:20. Everyone eats together in the cafeteria, and the menu is posted on the school website every month.
lines.ko: 점심은 4교시 끝나고 12시 20분이야. 다 같이 급식실에서 먹고, 식단표는 매달 학교 홈페이지에 올라와.
alt: It's after fourth period, at 12:20. We all eat in the cafeteria, and you can check the monthly menu on the school website.

lines.en: Um, I should tell you something. In my family, we don't eat pork.
lines.ko: 음, 말씀드릴 게 있어요. 저희 가족은 돼지고기를 안 먹어요.

lines.en: Thank you for telling me. That's really important. I'll talk to our nutrition teacher today, and she can mark which dishes have pork in them.
lines.ko: 말해 줘서 고마워. 정말 중요한 거야. 오늘 영양 선생님께 말씀드릴게. 돼지고기가 들어간 음식은 표시해 주실 거야.
alt: I'm glad you told me. That's important. I'll let the nutrition teacher know, and she'll mark the dishes that have pork.

lines.en: Thank you. Do I have to wear a uniform every day?
Yes, except on days when you have P.E. On those days, you can wear your gym clothes all day.
lines.ko: 응, 체육 있는 날만 빼고. 그날은 하루 종일 체육복을 입어도 돼.
alt: Yes, but on P.E. days, you can wear your gym clothes all day.

lines.en: What about my phone? Can I use it at lunch?
I'm afraid not. We collect phones during morning homeroom and give them back after school. If your parents need to reach you, they can call the teachers' room.
lines.ko: 미안하지만 안 돼. 아침 조회 때 휴대폰을 걷었다가 방과 후에 돌려줘. 부모님이 연락하셔야 하면 교무실로 전화하시면 돼.
alt: Sorry, no. We collect phones in the morning and return them after school. Your parents can call the teachers' room if they need you.

lines.en: Okay. It's different from my old school, but I'll get used to it.
lines.ko: 알겠어요. 전에 다니던 학교랑은 다르지만 적응할게요.

expressions.note: 학생이 어렵게 꺼낸 말을 받아 줄 때
